title: 森浦qeubee-MCP连接配置
description: 连接您的 qeubee 账号。X_ACCESS_KEY 仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下。
description_en: Connect your qeubee account. X_ACCESS_KEY is stored locally in ~/.workbuddy only.

fields.label: X_ACCESS_KEY
fields.placeholder: 请联系您的qeubee客户经理或线上客服获取X_ACCESS_KEY（格式ak-qb-xxx）
fields.placeholder_en: X_ACCESS_KEY issued by qeubee (ak-qb-xxx). Please contact your qeubee account manager or Help Desk to apply for X_ACCESS_KEY issued by qeubee.
fields.description: 用于访问森浦qeubee-MCP的访问密钥，以请求头 X_ACCESS_KEY 传递。
fields.description_en: X_ACCESS_KEY for the Sumscope qeubee MCP, passed via the X_ACCESS_KEY request header.
